description: This file implements a component of a network discovery and probing system within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It defines classes and methods for handling SSDP-like discovery requests, generating responses, managing discovery state, and reporting discovered devices with latency and security information.

classes.name: Discovery
classes.description: A helper class for constructing discovery response messages with various constructors for different discovery scenarios.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Handles incoming SSDP-like discovery requests, manages responses, and maintains state for discovery sessions.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Handles incoming responses from devices, validates them, and reports discovered devices with latency and security info.

classes.name: Probe::WebTransform
classes.description: Contains static methods for transforming Web requests, specifically for handling M-SEARCH requests.

methods.name: Probe::WebTransform::Transform
methods.description: Processes incoming Web::Request deserializer data to identify M-SEARCH requests and deserialize them if matched.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a text body to partial Web requests.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::Received
methods.description: Handles incoming discovery requests, validates them, and queues responses.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::Send
methods.description: Sends responses to discovery requests and manages the response queue.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::ValidRequest
methods.description: Validates incoming discovery requests, including optional signature validation.

methods.name: Probe::Listener::CreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a Web::Response with discovery information, including latency and optional security signature.

methods.name: Probe::Broadcaster::ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming response data, validates it, and reports discovered devices.

methods.name: Probe::Broadcaster::ValidResponse
methods.description: Validates the signature of a response message.

methods.name: Probe::Report
methods.description: Records a discovered device with its URL, latency, model, and security status.
